title: Buttons and commands
xaml:
<StackPanel xmlns="https://github.com/ferroui" Spacing="12">
  <TextBlock Text="A clear next step" FontSize="20" />
  <Button Content="Continue" HorizontalAlignment="Left" />
  <Button Content="Unavailable" IsEnabled="False" />
</StackPanel>

title: Text entry
xaml:
<StackPanel xmlns="https://github.com/ferroui" Spacing="12">
  <TextBlock Text="Your name" />
  <TextBox PlaceholderText="Enter a display name" />
  <TextBox Text="Try editing this text" />
</StackPanel>

title: Check boxes
xaml:
<StackPanel xmlns="https://github.com/ferroui" Spacing="12">
  <CheckBox Content="Send me updates" IsChecked="True" />
  <CheckBox Content="Remember this device" />
  <CheckBox Content="Indeterminate" IsThreeState="True" />
</StackPanel>

title: A binary setting
xaml:
<StackPanel xmlns="https://github.com/ferroui" Spacing="16">
  <ToggleSwitch Content="Notifications" IsChecked="True" />
  <ToggleSwitch Content="Quiet mode" />
</StackPanel>

title: Choose one option
xaml:
<StackPanel xmlns="https://github.com/ferroui" Spacing="12">
  <RadioButton Content="Light" GroupName="Appearance" IsChecked="True" />
  <RadioButton Content="Dark" GroupName="Appearance" />
  <RadioButton Content="System" GroupName="Appearance" />
</StackPanel>

title: Adjust a numeric value
xaml:
<StackPanel xmlns="https://github.com/ferroui" Spacing="16">
  <TextBlock Text="Volume" />
  <Slider Minimum="0" Maximum="100" Value="65" />
  <ProgressBar Minimum="0" Maximum="100" Value="65" />
</StackPanel>

title: Progress feedback
xaml:
<StackPanel xmlns="https://github.com/ferroui" Spacing="20">
  <TextBlock Text="Known progress" />
  <ProgressBar Minimum="0" Maximum="100" Value="42" />
  <TextBlock Text="Waiting for a result" />
  <ProgressBar IsIndeterminate="True" />
</StackPanel>

title: Compact selection
xaml:
<ComboBox xmlns="https://github.com/ferroui" SelectedIndex="0" Width="220">
  <ComboBoxItem>Personal workspace</ComboBoxItem>
  <ComboBoxItem>Team workspace</ComboBoxItem>
  <ComboBoxItem>Shared workspace</ComboBoxItem>
</ComboBox>

title: A responsive form
xaml:
<Grid xmlns="https://github.com/ferroui" ColumnDefinitions="Auto,*" RowDefinitions="Auto,Auto" Margin="12">
  <TextBlock Text="Name" Margin="0,0,16,12" />
  <TextBox Grid.Column="1" PlaceholderText="Your name" />
  <TextBlock Grid.Row="1" Text="Team" Margin="0,0,16,0" />
  <TextBox Grid.Row="1" Grid.Column="1" PlaceholderText="Your team" />
</Grid>

title: Arrange a simple flow
xaml:
<StackPanel xmlns="https://github.com/ferroui" Orientation="Horizontal" Spacing="12">
  <Button Content="Back" />
  <Button Content="Continue" />
  <Button Content="Cancel" />
</StackPanel>

title: Frame a region
xaml:
<Border xmlns="https://github.com/ferroui" BorderBrush="#8EA7DC" BorderThickness="1" CornerRadius="12" Padding="24">
  <TextBlock Text="A little breathing room." FontSize="18" />
</Border>

title: Readable text
xaml:
<StackPanel xmlns="https://github.com/ferroui" Spacing="12">
  <TextBlock Text="Type with purpose." FontSize="24" FontWeight="Bold" />
  <TextBlock Text="This text wraps when the available width gets smaller. Try changing the preview width." TextWrapping="Wrap" />
</StackPanel>

title: Optional details
xaml:
<Expander xmlns="https://github.com/ferroui" Header="More details" IsExpanded="True">
  <TextBlock Margin="12" Text="Keep the important information visible. Put supporting detail here." TextWrapping="Wrap" />
</Expander>

title: Related views
xaml:
<TabControl xmlns="https://github.com/ferroui">
  <TabItem Header="Overview"><TextBlock Margin="16" Text="The big picture." /></TabItem>
  <TabItem Header="Details"><TextBlock Margin="16" Text="A closer look." /></TabItem>
</TabControl>

title: Precise numeric input
xaml: <NumericUpDown xmlns="https://github.com/ferroui" Minimum="1" Maximum="20" Value="4" Increment="1" Width="180" />

title: A bounded scrolling region
xaml:
<ScrollViewer xmlns="https://github.com/ferroui" Height="140">
  <StackPanel Spacing="28">
    <TextBlock Text="First section" /><TextBlock Text="Second section" />
    <TextBlock Text="Third section" /><TextBlock Text="Fourth section" />
    <TextBlock Text="Fifth section" />
  </StackPanel>
</ScrollViewer>

title: Toggle a local state
xaml:
<StackPanel xmlns="https://github.com/ferroui" Orientation="Horizontal" Spacing="12">
  <ToggleButton Content="Bold" IsChecked="True" />
  <ToggleButton Content="Italic" />
</StackPanel>

title: A binding that updates as you type
xaml:
<StackPanel xmlns="https://github.com/ferroui"
            xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
            Spacing="12">
  <TextBlock Text="Edit the field to update the label" />
  <TextBox x:Name="Editor" Text="Hello, FerroUI" />
  <TextBlock x:Name="Echo" Text="{Binding Text, ElementName=Editor}" FontSize="20" />
</StackPanel>
